data.rationale: The proposal follows the same flow as the true workflow (Attractions tab, search, date picker, Search, open attraction, set ticket counts) and names destination, date and filters as parameters, but it adds optional filter/sort steps and a time-slot step that the true occurrence lacks, and it leaves guests only as ticket_counts, so it is concrete enough to automate but not an exact match.
